title: Every agent-transcript path comes from one home
why: Lane archive-guard-reads-agent-calls (#2224) added own_session.agent_transcript_path as the one home for an agent's transcript path. Four other copies built it by hand: hooks/guard_kill.py in_own_agent_worktree, hooks/stall_watch.py agent_transcripts, lint/report_guard.py tool_use_sources and lint/ruling_census.py agent_transcript_paths. Part (1) of this step, guards brief_hit (lane-one-topic) and trust_card_hit (trust-card-in-build) reading an agent's own calls, went stale when agent-no-remote-tools (PR #1674, step 8b of hooks/guard.py) landed: it refuses every agent call to send_message, confirm_repository_trust and request_computer_folder before those guards run, so their agent-transcript read can never fire (measured: 5 lane cases got deny from agent-no-remote-tools in /tmp/verdict logs of the merge of main 0e6509a96). Part (1) is dropped; part (2), the four copies calling the one home, stays.
note: From lane reviewer-no-session-tools (00:30 CST Nov 9): once #1674 merges, the session-tiers.md prose on the archive guard's agent-transcript branch comes to this lane; the code half is step archive-agent-branch-dead. Unblocked: #1674 merged in batch 70 (PR #2498, 0e6509a96, 00:52 CST Nov 10). Rewritten 00:59 CST Nov 10 on the coordinator's ruling, relayed by the lane: the stale-first order of brief_hit (stale check before the lane-tag pass) was dropped with part (1); if it closes a real hole, it is its own step with its incident.
